name: Zistgah / Project ILM estate ontology
purpose: A scaffold, not a finished ontology. The classes and relations are stable; the instances are seeded from a walk of the forge and are incomplete on purpose. Extend it.
rules: Retrieve before asserting. The live state is in the repository.
If the corpus does not establish a relationship, do not infer it.
A relation of kind shares_primitive must be declared at both ends.
Where a value is unknown write 'not established'. Do not estimate.
An ontology position is not a domain, and a projection is not a stage.
Nothing here is a claim about the world; it is a claim about this estate.

classes.name: Organisation
classes.definition: A forge account that holds repositories.

classes.name: Repository
classes.definition: One sovereign component. Carries its own contract and runs without the rest.

classes.name: Component
classes.definition: What a repository IS, independent of where it is hosted. The repository is the container; the component is the thing.

classes.name: Domain
classes.definition: A field of practice a component serves, placed on the ISIC x ISCO x ISCED lattice crossed with AGI layers.

classes.name: Lab
classes.definition: A reproducible environment for one domain, hardware through applications.

classes.name: DepositedWork
classes.definition: A DOI record. A concept DOI and a version DOI are different nodes.

classes.name: Page
classes.definition: A published surface readable without cloning.

classes.name: Contract
classes.definition: The rules a repository declares and can be judged against.

classes.name: Cycler
classes.definition: A configured prompt cycle. Classified by OUTPUT, never by input.

classes.name: Poster
classes.definition: A plate. Belongs to a corpus; a new plate for an existing corpus is a VERSION, never a new deposit.

classes.name: Claim
classes.definition: An assertion about the estate, with its source and date. Not a fact until checked against the forge.

relations.name: shares_primitive
relations.provenance: must be declared at BOTH ends, or it is a proposal and not a relation

relations.name: run_by
relations.provenance: declared in the registry, never in code

relations.name: priced_by
relations.provenance: a bill of materials whose prices carry a source

seeded_instances.note: Only four classes are populated by the walk: the forge knows about organisations, repositories, pages and deposited works and nothing else. Component, Domain, Lab, Contract, Cycler and Poster are UNPOPULATED, and filling them is the work.

worklist.how: read each repository's CONTEXT.md and CONTRACT.md; one component per repository unless the repository says otherwise
read descriptor.json where it exists; it already carries the ISIC, ISCO, ISCED and AGI-layer placement
the domain registry in the spine repository lists the enablement per domain; a lab kit is generated from it
every CONTRACT.md in the estate, and the master one in the governance repository that the rest inherit
the .pni configuration files; classified by OUTPUT
the poster repositories; a corpus is one concept DOI with versions beneath it
https://zistgah.org/memory-reconciliation.json is a worked example: assertions with sources, checked against the forge
